name: Withering Thicket
summary: The Withering Thicket is a shadowed stretch of woodland nestled along the coast of Darkshore north of Auberdine. Haunted by native predators like moonstalkers, the thicket reflects the lingering distress and sorrow that burdens northern Kalimdor's wilderness.

sections.title: A Troubled Woodland
sections.body: Located along Darkshore's mist-shrouded coast just north of the port settlement of Auberdine, the Withering Thicket embodies the uneasy quiet of the coastal forests. Densely shaded by ancient boughs, the area is prowled by fierce moonstalkers and other native beasts. Like much of Darkshore in the wake of the Third War, the land carries a subtle gloom, demanding wariness from travelers venturing off the main paths.

faq.q: Where is the Withering Thicket located?
aliases: how to get to withering thicket
faq.answer: The Withering Thicket lies in northern Darkshore, set along the coast just north of the night elf harbor settlement of Auberdine.

faq.q: What creatures are found in the Withering Thicket?
faq.answer: The woods are primarily home to native wildlife, most notably predatory moonstalkers that stalk the shaded coastal terrain.

aliases: why is it called withering thicket
faq.answer: Much of Darkshore suffers from persistent ecological decay and corruption following the Third War, giving many of its groves and coastlines a sickly, faded demeanor.

angles.text: The uneasy balance and troubled wildlife of groves like the Withering Thicket serve as constant reminders of the ongoing healing work required across Darkshore.
Close to the haven of Auberdine, the Withering Thicket is part of the ancestral territory kaldorei rangers and Sentinels must vigilantly monitor.
